description: Pinned corpus for the dircue parity atlas. Each entry has a URL, a full commit SHA, and a note. The smoke subset (atlas-smoke) uses the first five entries. Map-corpus entries are included here to provide a single authoritative corpus for all atlas runs; their pins match those in tests/map_corpus/public_expectations.json and tests/map_corpus/public_quality_expectations.json exactly.

repositories.note: Small Go CLI library; representative of a pure-Go repo with no workspace. Pinned from map_corpus.
Python web micro-framework; src layout with pyproject.toml. Pinned from map_corpus.
Rust CLI with Cargo workspace; exercises Rust grammar classification. Pinned from map_corpus.
Helm chart examples; IaC/YAML-only repo to exercise template classification. Pinned from map_corpus.

Linux kernel: deliberately hard case at scale. Exercises C/Assembly/Kconfig/Makefile classification and Linguist strategy chain (#72 regression). This is the reference entry for kernel wall-time budgets.
Node.js/JS web framework; exercises JavaScript classification and npm metadata. Pinned from map_corpus.
Apache Maven: Java/XML build tool; exercises Java classification and Maven POM detection. Pinned from map_corpus.
Rust + Python workspace (uv); exercises multi-language monorepo, Cargo workspace, and uv workspace detection. Pinned from map_corpus.
TypeScript compiler: large JS/TS monorepo; exercises TypeScript grammar classification at scale. Pinned from map_corpus.
Roslyn .NET compiler: large C# solution; exercises C# grammar at scale and VB regression (#73). Pinned from map_corpus.
ASP.NET Core: large multi-language .NET solution; exercises C#/TypeScript/JavaScript/HTML at scale. Pinned from map_corpus.
Spring Framework: large Java/Kotlin Gradle multi-module project. Pinned from map_corpus.
Ruby on Rails: large Ruby monorepo; exercises Ruby/ERB/JS classification. Pinned from map_corpus.
Laravel PHP framework; exercises PHP classification. Pinned from map_corpus.
jq: C-only project with custom grammar files; exercises C classification and unusual file extensions. Pinned from map_corpus.
ORAS OCI registry client: Go project with Makefile; exercises Go and CI workflows. Pinned from map_corpus.
Terraform AWS VPC module: pure IaC repo; exercises HCL/Terraform classification. Pinned from map_corpus.
Serverless Framework examples: multi-language serverless samples. Pinned from map_corpus.
Kotlin koans: exercises Kotlin classification. Pinned from map_corpus.
dotnet/samples: diverse C#/F#/VB samples; exercises multiple .NET languages. Pinned from map_corpus.
GCP Functions Framework for Python: serverless Python; exercises Python packaging. Pinned from map_corpus.
AWS SAM Java REST: serverless Java with SAM template; exercises Java + IaC. Pinned from map_corpus.
GCP Online Boutique microservices: 11 services across 8+ languages, Kubernetes, Helm; exercises polyglot classification and deployable detection. Pinned from map_corpus quality expectations.
dotnet/eShop: .NET microservices reference; exercises multi-service .NET composition with Docker Compose. Pinned from map_corpus quality expectations.
Spring PetClinic: canonical Java/Maven web app; exercises Java + Maven POM. Pinned from map_corpus quality expectations.
HashiCorp Terraform tutorial: tiny IaC-only repo; hardest case for language classification (HCL only). Pinned from map_corpus quality expectations.
Kubernetes: large Go monorepo with vendor/; exercises large-scale Go classification, vendored code detection, and generated files.
React: JS/TS monorepo with multiple packages (packages/ layout); exercises monorepo component detection.
Django: large Python web framework; exercises Python classification at scale with many test files.
Jellyfin: large C# media server with Docker and YAML config; exercises C# at scale with container metadata.
BioPerl: deliberately Perl-heavy repo as required by the atlas spec; exercises Perl classification which is a known hard case for Linguist.
NixOS nixpkgs: extremely large Nix-only monorepo; exercises Nix classification at scale and large-repo performance.
HashiCorp Terraform: Go CLI with embedded HCL processing; exercises Go and HCL classification in one repo.
GitHub Actions toolkit: CI-heavy TypeScript monorepo; exercises CI workflow detection and TypeScript monorepo layout.
pnpm: TypeScript/JS monorepo with pnpm workspace; deliberately hard case for JS workspace detection.
Next.js: large TypeScript/JS monorepo with packages/ and examples/; exercises TypeScript and JS classification at scale.
Prometheus: Go monitoring system; exercises Go classification with embedded assets.
Traefik: Go reverse proxy with extensive YAML/TOML config; exercises Go and IaC classification.
